Preserve existing formatting — Extra spaces inside ⚠ Measured 2026-08-29 against jb cleanupcode 2025.2.6, one key flipped at a time over the export in an appended [*.cs] section — the sweep's own method — and classified implementable — the oracle honours it and Skala does not. Two distinct oracle outputs: remove_all and leave_tabs normalise var a = ( p ); and M( p );, while leave_all and leave_multiple keep the inner spacing. Skala is flat at all four and matches the export's remove_all. Baseline agrees, so the divergence is the key's — but an oracle glob would report INERT.

Typeone of remove_all, leave_tabs, leave_multiple, leave_all
